import os, re, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlparse

slug_filter = (p.get('slug_filter') or '').strip()
max_slugs = int(p.get('max_slugs') or 0)
force_rebuild = p.get('force_rebuild', True)

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

def _sign(method, bucket, key='', qs=''):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    eh = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    cu = '/' + bucket + ('/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/') if key else '')
    ch = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{eh}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    sh = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    cr = f'{method}\n{cu}\n{qs}\n{ch}\n{sh}\n{eh}'
    cs = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    sts = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{cs}\n{hashlib.sha256(cr.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _s(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    kd = _s(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp); kr = _s(kd, region); ks = _s(kr, 's3'); ksi = _s(ks, 'aws4_request')
    sig = hmac.new(ksi, sts.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{cs}, SignedHeaders={sh}, Signature={sig}'
    return f'{endpoint}{cu}' + (f'?{qs}' if qs else ''), {'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': eh, 'Authorization': auth}

def list_prefixes(bucket, prefix=''):
    qs = 'delimiter=' + urllib.parse.quote('/', safe='') + '&list-type=2&prefix=' + urllib.parse.quote(prefix, safe='')
    url, h = _sign('GET', bucket, qs=qs)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h), timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read().decode('utf-8')

xml = list_prefixes(source_bucket)

if max_slugs > 0: slugs = slugs[:max_slugs]

if not slugs:

}} for i, s in enumerate(slugs)]

def as_bool(value, default=False):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    return str(value).strip().lower() in ('1', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 'on')

def _sign(method, bucket, key='', qs='', payload=b''):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')

    sh = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'

def s3_get(bucket, key):
    url, h = _sign('GET', bucket, key=key)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h), timeout=120) as r:
        return r.read()

def s3_put(bucket, key, data, ct='application/octet-stream'):
    url, h = _sign('PUT', bucket, key=key, payload=data)
    h['Content-Type'] = ct
    rq = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='PUT', headers=h)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=180) as r:
        return r.status

def s3_head(bucket, key):
    url, h = _sign('HEAD', bucket, key=key)
    rq = urllib.request.Request(url, method='HEAD', headers=h)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=30) as r:
            return int(r.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code == 404: return None
        raise

def s3_list(bucket, prefix):
    qs = 'list-type=2&prefix=' + urllib.parse.quote(prefix, safe='')
    url, h = _sign('GET', bucket, qs=qs)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h), timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read().decode('utf-8')

def story_sample(text, limit):
    text = re.sub(r'\r\n?', '\n', text).strip()
    limit = max(limit, 30000)
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    part = max(limit // 3, 4000)
    start = text[:part].strip()
    mid_at = max((len(text) // 2) - (part // 2), 0)
    middle = text[mid_at:mid_at + part].strip()
    end = text[-part:].strip()
    return (
        '[BEGINNING]\n' + start +
        '\n\n[MIDDLE]\n' + middle +
        '\n\n[ENDING]\n' + end
    )[:limit + 80]

def clean_list(value, limit=8):
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        return []
    out = []
    for item in value:
        s = str(item).strip()
        if s and s not in out:
            out.append(s)
    return out[:limit]

def text_value(value, default=''):
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, list):
        parts = [text_value(item, '') for item in value]
        joined = '; '.join(part for part in parts if part)
        return joined or default
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        try:
            return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
        except Exception:
            return str(value).strip() or default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default

def build_story_prompts(prompts):
    title = text_value(prompts.get('story_title_vi'), '')

    protector = text_value(prompts.get('protector'), '')
    if protector.lower() in ('null', 'none', 'không có', 'khong co'):
        protector = ''
    setting = text_value(prompts.get('primary_setting'), 'the most important location from the story')
    emotional_hook = text_value(prompts.get('emotional_hook'), 'the central emotional twist of the story')
    thumbnail_scene = text_value(prompts.get('thumbnail_scene'), 'the most dramatic turning point from the story')
    background_scene = text_value(prompts.get('background_scene'), setting)
    palette = text_value(prompts.get('color_palette'), 'cinematic warm and cool contrast matching the story mood')
    objects = clean_list(prompts.get('key_objects'), 8)
    objects_4 = ', '.join(objects[:4]) if objects else 'story-specific symbolic objects from the plot'
    objects_6 = ', '.join(objects[:6]) if objects else 'story-specific symbolic objects from the plot'
    story_lock = text_value(prompts.get('story_image_brief'), '')

    protector_clause = f'Include {protector} only as a secondary supporting figure, visually distinct from the protagonist. ' if protector else 'Do not add a protector character unless the story clearly has one. '
    thumbnail_prompt = (
        f'Exact-story cinematic 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for "{title}". '
        f'STORY LOCK: {story_lock} Summary: {summary} '
        f'Depict this specific turning point: {thumbnail_scene}. '

def _sign(method, bucket, key='', qs='', payload=b''):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    ph = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() if payload else 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    cu = '/' + bucket + ('/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/') if key else '')
    ch = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{ph}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    sh = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    cr = f'{method}\n{cu}\n{qs}\n{ch}\n{sh}\n{ph}'
    cs = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    sts = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{cs}\n{hashlib.sha256(cr.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _s(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    kd = _s(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp); kr = _s(kd, region); ks = _s(kr, 's3'); ksi = _s(ks, 'aws4_request')
    sig = hmac.new(ksi, sts.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{cs}, SignedHeaders={sh}, Signature={sig}'
    return f'{endpoint}{cu}' + (f'?{qs}' if qs else ''), {'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': ph, 'Authorization': auth}

def s3_put(bucket, key, data, ct='application/octet-stream'):
    url, h = _sign('PUT', bucket, key=key, payload=data)
    h['Content-Type'] = ct
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='PUT', headers=h), timeout=180) as r:
        return r.status

def build_flux_wf(prompt, width, height, seed, filename_prefix):
    return {
        '1': {'class_type': 'UNETLoader', 'inputs': {'unet_name': 'flux1-dev.safetensors', 'weight_dtype': 'default'}},
        '2': {'class_type': 'DualCLIPLoader', 'inputs': {'clip_name1': 'clip_l.safetensors', 'clip_name2': 't5xxl_fp16.safetensors', 'type': 'flux', 'device': 'default'}},
        '3': {'class_type': 'VAELoader', 'inputs': {'vae_name': 'ae.safetensors'}},
        '4': {'class_type': 'CLIPTextEncode', 'inputs': {'clip': ['2', 0], 'text': prompt}},
        '5': {'class_type': 'FluxGuidance', 'inputs': {'conditioning': ['4', 0], 'guidance': 3.5}},
        '6': {'class_type': 'EmptyLatentImage', 'inputs': {'width': width, 'height': height, 'batch_size': 1}},
        '7': {'class_type': 'ConditioningZeroOut', 'inputs': {'conditioning': ['4', 0]}},
        '8': {'class_type': 'KSampler', 'inputs': {'model': ['1', 0], 'positive': ['5', 0], 'negative': ['7', 0], 'latent_image': ['6', 0], 'seed': seed, 'steps': 20, 'cfg': 1.0, 'sampler_name': 'euler', 'scheduler': 'normal', 'denoise': 1.0}},
        '9': {'class_type': 'VAEDecode', 'inputs': {'samples': ['8', 0], 'vae': ['3', 0]}},
        '10': {'class_type': 'SaveImage', 'inputs': {'images': ['9', 0], 'filename_prefix': filename_prefix}}
    }

def comfy_run(wf, timeout_s=600):
    body = json.dumps({'prompt': wf, 'client_id': str(uuid.uuid4())}).encode()
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{COMFY}/prompt', data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=30) as r:
        resp = json.loads(r.read())
    pid = resp.get('prompt_id')
    if not pid: return None
    deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
    while time.time() < deadline:
        time.sleep(4)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f'{COMFY}/history/{pid}', timeout=15) as r:
            h = json.loads(r.read())
        if pid in h:
            return h[pid].get('outputs', {})
    return None

def comfy_fetch(filename, subfolder=''):
    url = f"{COMFY}/view?filename={urllib.parse.quote(filename)}&subfolder={urllib.parse.quote(subfolder)}&type=output"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as r:
        return r.read()
